capacity_commitment_id.description:
The optional capacity commitment ID. Capacity commitment name will be generated automatically if this field is
empty. This field must only contain lower case alphanumeric characters or dashes. The first and last character
cannot be a dash. Max length is 64 characters. NOTE: this ID won't be kept if the capacity commitment is split
or merged.
capacity_commitment_id.rationale: This is just a naming/identifier field and does not impact security or access to the resource.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

edition.description: The edition type. Valid values are STANDARD, ENTERPRISE, ENTERPRISE_PLUS
edition.rationale: This controls the product edition level but does not directly change security settings such as encryption or access.

enforce_single_admin_project_per_org.description: If true, fail the request if another project in the organization has a capacity commitment.
enforce_single_admin_project_per_org.rationale: This is more of an organisation/admin control to avoid conflicts, but it does not directly change access control or security settings.

location.description:
The geographic location where the transfer config should reside.
Examples: US, EU, asia-northeast1. The default value is US.
location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

plan.description: Capacity commitment plan. Valid values are at https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/reservations/rpc/google.cloud.bigquery.reservation.v1#commitmentplan
plan.rationale: This decides the commitment plan type but it does not directly affect security settings like IAM or data protection.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: This only tells Terraform what project to use and does not automatically change security settings by itself.

renewal_plan.description: The plan this capacity commitment is converted to after commitmentEndTime passes. Once the plan is changed, committed period is extended according to commitment plan. Only applicable for some commitment plans.
renewal_plan.rationale: This is only related to billing/plan rollover and does not change access permissions or security controls.

slot_count.description: Number of slots in this commitment.
slot_count.rationale: This mainly controls performance/capacity and does not change access control, permissions, or encryption settings.
